[P2] Release pending dispatch payloads when abandoning the worker

Cancelling these futures does not remove their `(future, fn)` entries from `_HookWorker._items`. If the running hook never returns, the worker never consumes those entries or its stop marker, so every cancelled closure, copied context, and full operation-map snapshot remains retained after the invocation closes. Repeated invocations in a reused process can accumulate substantial memory indefinitely. Remove and release pending worker queue entries when dispatch closes, leaving only the running callback retained, and test that queued payloads are released while that callback remains blocked.
